recipes.title: Homestyle Chicken Pot Pie
recipes.description: A creamy chicken-and-vegetable filling beneath a flaky golden crust.
recipes.image_license: @joefoodie; CC BY 2.0; photo https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chicken_Pot_Pie.jpg; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F (205°C). Melt butter in a pan and soften onion and carrots for 6 minutes.
Stir in flour for 1 minute, then slowly whisk in chicken broth and milk until smooth.
Simmer until thickened, about 5 minutes; stir in chicken, peas and thyme and season.
Pour filling into a deep pie dish, cover with crust, crimp edges and cut three small steam slits.
Brush crust with egg and bake 30–35 minutes until golden and the filling bubbles. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: One-Pot Beef and Bean Chili
recipes.description: Smoky tomato-rich chili that gets even better as it simmers.
recipes.image_license: MartinThoma; CC0 1.0; photo https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chili-con-Carne.jpg; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/
instructions: Brown the ground beef in a heavy pot over medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes; drain excess fat.
Add onion and pepper; cook for 5 minutes, then stir in garlic, chili powder, cumin and paprika for 30 seconds.
Add tomatoes, kidney beans and broth and stir thoroughly.
Bring to a gentle bubble, lower heat and simmer uncovered for 35–40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt and pepper. Serve with rice, shredded cheese or chopped green onion.

recipes.title: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
recipes.description: Tall, tender breakfast pancakes with buttery edges and maple syrup.
recipes.image_license: Theo Crazzolara; CC BY-SA 4.0; photo https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pancake_with_maple_syrup.jpg; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/
ingredients: Butter and maple syrup, for serving
instructions: Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
Beat buttermilk, egg and melted butter together in a separate bowl.
Pour wet ingredients into dry and stir just until combined; some small lumps should remain.
Warm a lightly buttered nonstick skillet on medium heat. Add 1/4 cup batter per pancake.
Cook 2–3 minutes until bubbles appear and edges look set, flip and cook 1–2 minutes more until the centers are cooked.
Serve warm with butter and maple syrup.

recipes.title: Golden Grilled Cheese Sandwich
recipes.description: Crisp buttery toast wrapped around melted cheddar.
recipes.image_license: Gogerr; CC BY-SA 4.0; photo https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Grilled_Cheese_Sandwich_on_White_Bread.jpg; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/
instructions: Spread a thin layer of butter over one side of every bread slice.
Lay two slices butter-side down and divide cheddar and mozzarella across the bread.
Close with the remaining slices, buttered sides facing out.
Place sandwiches in a skillet over medium-low heat and cook for 3–4 minutes per side, pressing lightly.
If bread browns before cheese melts, lower heat and cover pan briefly; serve immediately.

recipes.title: Creamy Baked Mac and Cheese
recipes.description: Tender macaroni folded into a silky cheddar sauce, finished with a crisp golden top.
recipes.image_license: Sheena Aloner; CC BY-SA 4.0; photo: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mac_and_Cheese.jpg; license conditions apply
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly butter an 8-by-11-inch baking dish.
Boil the macaroni in salted water until 2 minutes shy of the package's al dente time, then drain.
Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat; whisk in flour for 1 minute, then gradually whisk in warm milk until smooth.
Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until thick enough to coat a spoon, then turn heat low and stir in mustard, paprika and cheeses until melted.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper, fold in macaroni and spread in the baking dish.
Sprinkle breadcrumbs over the top and bake 18–22 minutes until bubbling and golden. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Creamy Garlic Mashed Potatoes
recipes.description: Silky mashed potatoes with roasted garlic flavor and plenty of butter.
recipes.image_license: Pastorius; CC BY-SA 3.0; photo https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mashed_potatoes.jpg; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/
ingredients: 2 lb Yukon Gold potatoes, peeled and cut
instructions: Place potatoes and garlic in a pot and cover with cold salted water by 1 inch.
Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer and cook 15–20 minutes until potatoes are very tender.
Drain well and let steam dry for 1 minute in the pot.
Mash potatoes and garlic with butter until fluffy, then slowly fold in warm milk.
Season with salt and black pepper; sprinkle with chives and serve hot.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches
recipes.description: Tender pulled pork tossed with a tangy barbecue sauce.
recipes.image_license: jeffreyw; CC BY 2.0; photo https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pulled_pork_sandwich.jpg; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/
instructions: Combine paprika, garlic powder and salt and rub evenly over pork shoulder.
Place pork in a slow cooker with chicken broth and vinegar; cover and cook on LOW for 7–8 hours until fork-tender.
Transfer pork to a board; discard excess fat and shred with two forks.
Skim fat from cooking liquid, return shredded pork to the cooker, then mix in barbecue sauce and brown sugar.
Cook on HIGH for another 15 minutes until thoroughly hot. Spoon onto buns with coleslaw.

recipes.title: Southern Shrimp and Cheddar Grits
recipes.description: Creamy cheddar grits topped with garlicky shrimp and a buttery pan sauce.
recipes.image_license: vxla; CC BY 2.0; photo https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shrimp_and_Grits_at_Lüke_Restaurant.jpg; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/
instructions: Bring water or broth to a simmer, whisk in grits and cook as directed until creamy, stirring often.
Turn off heat and stir cheddar and 1 tablespoon butter into grits; cover to keep warm.
Pat shrimp dry and season with salt, pepper and paprika.
Heat remaining butter in a skillet, sauté shrimp for 2–3 minutes per side until opaque and cooked through.
Add garlic for the final 30 seconds; remove from heat and toss with lemon juice.
Spoon grits into bowls and top with shrimp, pan juices and scallions.

recipes.title: Golden Skillet Cornbread
recipes.description: Tender cornmeal bread baked in a hot skillet for crisp buttery edges.
recipes.image_license: Wheeler Cowperthwaite; CC BY-SA 2.0; photo https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Corn_Bread_1A.jpg; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/
instructions: Place a 9-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven and preheat to 425°F (220°C).
Whisk cornmeal, flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and sugar together.
In another bowl whisk buttermilk, eggs and melted butter; stir into dry ingredients until just combined.
Carefully remove the hot skillet, melt the remaining tablespoon of butter and swirl to coat.
Pour in batter and bake 20–23 minutes until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool for 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Weeknight Sloppy Joe Sandwiches
recipes.description: Saucy, sweet-tangy ground beef tucked into soft toasted buns.
recipes.image_license: jeffreyw; CC BY 2.0; photo https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sloppy_joe_sandwiches.jpg; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/
instructions: Cook ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat until browned; drain excess fat.
Add onion and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes, then stir in garlic for 30 seconds.
Mix in tomato sauce, ketchup, Worcestershire, mustard and brown sugar.
Simmer gently for 8–10 minutes until thick enough to spoon onto a bun, then taste for salt and pepper.
Toast buns lightly, divide beef mixture among them and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Chocolate Brigadeiro Truffles
recipes.description: Soft Brazilian chocolate fudge candies rolled in sprinkles.
recipes.image_license: Rodrigogomesonetwo; CC BY-SA 4.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Brigadeiros.jpg; see file page for license
instructions: Mix condensed milk, cocoa and butter in a small heavy saucepan.
Cook over medium-low heat, stirring constantly, for 10–15 minutes until thick and pulling away from the bottom.
Transfer to a lightly buttered plate and cool completely.
With lightly buttered hands, roll tablespoon portions into small balls.
Roll each ball in chocolate sprinkles and serve in paper candy cups.

recipes.title: Crispy Brazilian Chicken Coxinhas
recipes.description: Golden, teardrop-shaped croquettes filled with shredded chicken.
recipes.image_license: Ludo Games-T; CC BY-SA 4.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Coxinha!.jpg; see file page for license
instructions: Sauté onion in olive oil until soft; add garlic for 30 seconds and stir in chicken, cream cheese, parsley, salt and pepper.
Bring broth and butter to a boil, add flour all at once and stir firmly over low heat until a smooth dough pulls away from the pan.
Cool dough enough to handle and divide into 12 portions.
Flatten each portion, fill with chicken and pinch closed into a teardrop shape.
Dip croquettes into beaten egg and coat completely in breadcrumbs.
Fry in 350°F (175°C) oil for 4–5 minutes until deep golden and heated through; drain on a rack.

recipes.title: Brazilian Black Bean Feijoada
recipes.description: A comforting Brazilian black bean stew with smoky sausage, served with rice and orange.
recipes.image_license: Andre S. Ribeiro; CC BY 2.0; photo: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Feijoada_completa.jpg; license conditions apply
ingredients: 1 lb pork shoulder, cut into 1-inch cubes
3 cans (15 oz each) black beans, drained and rinsed
Steamed white rice and sliced oranges to serve
instructions: Heat oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat and brown the pork cubes on all sides in batches.
Reduce heat to medium, add onion and sliced sausage, and cook for 6 minutes until onion softens.
Stir in garlic and cumin for 30 seconds; add black beans, broth, bay leaves and browned pork.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer gently for 60–75 minutes until pork is fork-tender; add a splash of water if the pot dries.
Mash a spoonful of beans against the side of the pot to thicken the stew; simmer uncovered for another 5 minutes.
Remove bay leaves, taste for salt and pepper, and serve steaming hot over rice with orange slices.

recipes.title: Bahian Coconut Fish Moqueca
recipes.description: A fragrant fish stew with coconut milk, tomatoes, peppers and lime.
recipes.image_license: BR; CC BY-SA 4.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Moqueca.jpg; see file page for license
instructions: Season fish with salt and lime juice and refrigerate while preparing the vegetables.
Heat oil in a wide pot and sauté onion and peppers for 5 minutes.
Add garlic and tomatoes and cook for 4 minutes.
Pour in coconut milk, bring to a gentle simmer, and nestle fish pieces into the sauce.
Cover and simmer for 10–12 minutes until fish reaches 145°F (63°C) and flakes easily.
Finish with cilantro and serve with hot white rice.

recipes.title: Brazilian Pão de Queijo
recipes.description: Naturally gluten-free cheese rolls with a crisp shell and chewy center.
recipes.image_license: 18610 Arthurdent; CC BY-SA 4.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pão_de_Queijo.jpg; see file page for license
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease a mini muffin pan.
Warm milk, oil and salt until steaming, then remove from heat.
Stir in tapioca flour and cool until the dough is just warm.
Beat in eggs one at a time and fold in cheese until smooth.
Divide into 18 mini muffin cups and bake 20–25 minutes until puffed and golden.
Cool for 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Classic Cinnamon Apple Pie
recipes.description: A warm double-crust apple pie with cinnamon and a flaky golden finish.
recipes.image_license: Larry D. Moore; CC BY 4.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:American_apple_pie.jpg; see file page for reuse terms
ingredients: 6 medium apples, peeled and sliced thin
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F (220°C) and line a 9-inch pie dish with one pastry crust.
Toss apples with sugar, flour, cinnamon, nutmeg and lemon juice until evenly coated.
Pile apples into the prepared shell and dot with small butter pieces.
Place the second crust over the apples, seal edges well and cut several steam vents.
Brush with beaten egg, bake 15 minutes at 425°F, then lower heat to 375°F (190°C) and bake 35–40 minutes until fruit bubbles and pastry is golden.
Cool at least 2 hours before slicing so the juices set.

recipes.title: Soft Cinnamon Banana Bread
recipes.description: Moist banana loaf with a caramelized crust and a hint of cinnamon.
recipes.image_license: Sarah; CC BY 2.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Banana_bread.jpg; see file page for reuse terms
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a 9-by-5-inch loaf tin with parchment.
Mash bananas with a fork and stir in melted butter, brown sugar, egg and vanilla.
Whisk baking soda, salt, flour and cinnamon in another bowl.
Fold dry ingredients into wet mixture just until no visible flour remains.
Transfer to the pan and bake 50–60 minutes until a skewer inserted in the center comes out clean.
Cool 15 minutes in the tin, then transfer to a rack before slicing.

recipes.title: Soft-Center Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Golden cookies with crisp edges, soft centers and generous pockets of chocolate.
recipes.image_license: Urvi Yagnik; CC BY-SA 4.0; photo: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chocolate_Chip_Cookies_1.jpg; license conditions apply
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C) and line two baking sheets with parchment.
Beat butter and both sugars together for 2 minutes until fluffy; mix in egg and vanilla.
In another bowl whisk flour, baking soda and salt; fold the dry ingredients into the butter mixture until just combined.
Stir in chocolate chips and scoop dough into 18 mounds spaced 2 inches apart.
Bake for 10–12 minutes until edges are set and golden but centers still look slightly soft.
Cool on the baking sheets for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack to finish cooling.

recipes.title: Fudgy Chocolate Brownies
recipes.description: Dense, chocolate-rich brownies with shiny tops and tender centers.
recipes.image_license: Photo: Antoine (Antoinel), CC BY-SA 3.0; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/ ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Brownies.jpg; unchanged
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C), line an 8-inch square pan with parchment and grease lightly.
Melt butter and whisk in sugar, then add eggs and vanilla and beat until glossy.
Sift cocoa, flour, salt and baking powder together and gently fold into the egg mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips and spread evenly in the prepared pan.
Bake 22–27 minutes until edges are set and a toothpick has a few moist crumbs; do not overbake.
Cool completely in the pan before cutting into 16 squares.

recipes.title: Bright Lemon Shortbread Bars
recipes.description: Sweet-tart lemon custard on a buttery shortbread base.
recipes.image_license: Dracunculus; public domain; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lemon_bars.jpg; see file page for reuse terms
instructions: Heat oven to 350°F (175°C) and line an 8-inch square pan with parchment.
Combine 1 cup flour and powdered sugar and rub in cold butter until the crumbs clump together.
Press into the pan and bake for 15–18 minutes until lightly golden.
Whisk sugar, eggs, lemon juice, 2 tablespoons flour and lemon zest until smooth.
Pour onto the warm crust and bake 20–24 minutes more until the middle is just set.
Cool completely, chill 1 hour, dust with powdered sugar and cut into squares.

recipes.title: Smoky Baba Ganoush
recipes.description: Silky roasted eggplant dip blended with lemon and tahini.
recipes.image_license: takaokun; CC BY 2.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Baba_ganoush_and_pita.jpg; see file page for license
instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C) and pierce the eggplants several times with a fork.
Roast on a lined baking tray for 30–35 minutes until softened and collapsed.
Cool slightly, split the eggplants and scoop out flesh, discarding peels and excess liquid.
Mash the roasted eggplant with tahini, lemon juice, garlic, olive oil, salt and paprika.
Adjust seasoning, spoon into a bowl and garnish with parsley.

recipes.title: Herby Crispy Falafel
recipes.description: Golden chickpea patties seasoned with cumin, coriander and fresh herbs.
recipes.image_license: NB; CC BY-SA 3.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Falafel.jpg; see file page for license
instructions: Soak dried chickpeas in cold water for 12–18 hours, then drain thoroughly without cooking.
Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic and herbs in a food processor until finely chopped but not a paste.
Mix in cumin, coriander, baking powder, salt and flour, then refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Shape into 12 small firm patties, pressing well so they hold together.
Heat frying oil to 350°F (175°C), fry each side for 3–4 minutes until deeply golden and cooked throughout.
Drain on a rack and serve with tahini sauce and pita.

recipes.title: Lemon-Tahini Hummus
recipes.description: A creamy chickpea dip with bright lemon, garlic and velvety tahini.
recipes.image_license: Donovan Govan; CC BY-SA 3.0; photo: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hummus.jpg; license conditions apply
ingredients: 2 cans (15 oz each) chickpeas, drained and rinsed
3 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, plus more to serve
Sweet paprika and parsley to garnish
instructions: Put tahini and lemon juice in a food processor and blend for 1 minute until pale and creamy.
Add garlic, olive oil, cumin and salt; blend 30 seconds, scraping down the sides.
Add half the chickpeas and blend 1 minute, then add the rest and process until mostly smooth.
With the motor running, drizzle in ice-cold water one tablespoon at a time until light and fluffy.
Taste and adjust with a pinch of salt or more lemon juice.
Spoon into a bowl, swirl the top, drizzle with olive oil and finish with paprika and parsley. Serve with vegetables or warm pita.

recipes.title: Tomato-Pepper Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs gently poached in a skillet of spiced tomatoes and sweet pepper.
recipes.image_license: Myriam Damaris R; CC BY-SA 2.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Shakshuka.jpg; see file page for license
instructions: Warm oil in a deep skillet and cook onion and pepper for 6–8 minutes until soft.
Stir in garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 30 seconds without burning.
Pour in tomatoes and simmer uncovered for 10–12 minutes until thickened.
Create wells in the tomato mixture and carefully add the eggs.
Cover and gently cook until the egg whites are fully set, approximately 5–8 minutes; cook yolks longer as desired.
Scatter chopped parsley over the top and serve warm with bread.

recipes.title: Fresh Parsley Tabbouleh
recipes.description: A lemony herb-and-bulgur salad with tomatoes, parsley and fresh mint.
recipes.image_license: Toniher; CC BY-SA 3.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tabbouleh.jpg; see file page for license
instructions: Cover the bulgur with boiling water and leave for 15 minutes, then drain and cool.
Wash and completely dry the parsley and mint before finely chopping.
Combine herbs, bulgur, tomatoes and scallions in a salad bowl.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil and salt in a small bowl until combined.
Toss the dressing through the salad, rest for 10 minutes and serve cool.

recipes.title: Three-Cheese Baked Ziti
recipes.description: Bubbly tomato-baked ziti with ricotta, mozzarella and Parmesan.
recipes.image_license: Lili from NY; CC BY 2.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Baked_Ziti.jpg; refer to file page for license
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C) and grease a medium casserole dish.
Boil ziti in salted water until 2 minutes before al dente; drain.
Heat oil in a small pan and stir garlic for 30 seconds; add marinara and oregano and warm through.
Toss drained pasta with marinara and half of the mozzarella.
Layer half the pasta into the dish, spoon on ricotta, then add remaining pasta and sprinkle mozzarella and Parmesan.
Bake uncovered for 25–30 minutes until bubbling and golden; rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Slow-Simmered Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.description: A hearty tomato and beef ragù clinging to tender spaghetti.
recipes.image_license: Noblige; CC BY-SA 2.5; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Spaghetti_bolognese.jpg; refer to file page for license
instructions: Heat olive oil in a heavy pot and soften onion, carrot and celery for 7 minutes.
Add beef and cook until browned all over, then stir in garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and broth, season lightly and bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered over low heat for 40–45 minutes, stirring often and adding water if too thick.
Boil spaghetti until al dente and reserve a little cooking water.
Toss the spaghetti with ragù, loosening with cooking water if needed, and serve with Parmesan.

recipes.title: Classic Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.description: Roman-style spaghetti with a glossy egg-and-pecorino sauce, black pepper and crisp guanciale.
recipes.image_license: Ed Hawco; CC BY-SA 3.0; photo: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Classic-spaghetti-carbonara.jpg; license conditions apply
ingredients: 3 large egg yolks and 1 whole egg
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it lightly because the cheese and guanciale are salty.
Whisk egg yolks, whole egg, Pecorino and black pepper in a bowl until a thick paste forms.
Cook guanciale in a large skillet over medium-low heat for 6–8 minutes until the fat renders and edges become crisp; turn off heat.
Boil spaghetti until just al dente and reserve at least 1 cup of starchy cooking water before draining.
Transfer spaghetti to the warm skillet, toss in rendered fat and add 1/4 cup cooking water; let cool briefly so the eggs will not scramble.
Off the heat, toss vigorously with the egg-cheese mixture, adding cooking water a splash at a time until glossy and creamy. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Creamy Fettuccine Alfredo
recipes.description: Tender fettuccine coated in an easy buttery Parmesan cream sauce.
recipes.image_license: Photo: Robert Banh, CC BY 2.0; https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/ ; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Fettuccine_Alfredo.jpg; unchanged
ingredients: Salt and freshly ground black pepper
instructions: Cook fettuccine in plenty of salted water until al dente, reserving 1 cup cooking water.
Melt butter gently in a large skillet and cook minced garlic for 30 seconds.
Pour in cream and simmer over low heat for 3 minutes, without boiling hard.
Turn off heat, stir in Parmesan and whisk until smooth.
Toss pasta with sauce, adding pasta water a few tablespoons at a time until silky.
Season with pepper, sprinkle parsley over the top and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Colorful Pasta Primavera
recipes.description: A fresh, light pasta packed with sautéed seasonal vegetables and lemon.
recipes.image_license: Jeremy Keith; CC BY 2.0; https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pasta_primavera.jpg; refer to file page for license
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water until just al dente, reserving 1/2 cup cooking water before draining.
Heat oil in a large skillet; add broccoli, zucchini and bell pepper and cook for 5–7 minutes until just tender.
Stir in garlic and tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes, keeping tomatoes intact.
Toss drained pasta with vegetables, lemon zest, lemon juice and a splash of cooking water.
Stir in Parmesan, season with salt and pepper, and garnish with torn basil.
